output_geometry.effective_envelope: approximately double-wide relative to one output
output_geometry.transform_relationship: one output is mirror-inverted relative to the other
output_geometry.visible_effect: shapes have opposite handedness and commanded movement appears mirrored between the two halves
output_geometry.inversion_axis: to be confirmed during physical DMX mapping

fixture.mirror_note_source: Owner-provided physical observation; not stated in the scanned DMX pages

notes: CH1 values 0-9 are the documented laser-off range.
The internal mirror creates two side-by-side beams from the front face, making the combined output envelope approximately double-wide; contain and verify the entire envelope before enabling CH1.
The two halves are not identical copies: one is mirror-inverted, so shape handedness and apparent motion differ across the combined envelope.
Keep output disabled until address, interlock, key switch, scan-fail behavior, and physical beam termination are verified.
Never direct either output path toward people, reflective surfaces, windows, roads, or aircraft.
